principles: Avoid generic recycled posts and engagement bait
Use firsthand expertise and concrete examples
Format for scanning without artificial one-line spam

deep_dive.note: range is guidance, not a ranking rule

length_guidance.post: Use enough detail to teach; 200-300 words is a useful educational baseline, not a hard optimum.

link_policy: No universal external-link penalty is encoded. Test placement by account and objective; never obscure the destination.
